name: mermaid-order-cancel-deepseek-v4.1-flash-s1-r1
caseTitle: Mermaid: a café order that can be cancelled
prompt: Draw a Mermaid stateDiagram-v2 for a café coffee order. An order is placed, paid, queued, brewed and collected, and it can be cancelled at any point before it is collected. Money goes back only if it was taken. Label every transition with exactly one of these events: pay, queue, start, finish, collect, cancel, refund.

source.text:
stateDiagram-v2
    [*] --> Placed
    Placed --> Paid : pay
    Paid --> Queued : queue
    Queued --> Brewing : start
    Brewing --> Brewed : finish
    Brewed --> Collected : collect

    Placed --> Abandoned : cancel
    Abandoned --> [*]

    Paid --> Cancelled : cancel
    Queued --> Cancelled : cancel
    Brewing --> Cancelled : cancel
    Brewed --> Cancelled : cancel
    Cancelled --> Refunded : refund
    Refunded --> [*]

    Collected --> [*]
